protocol_rule: Independence is evaluated against the pathway by which shared information could force the agreement being presented as evidence.

P0Q1_revised_rule_development.reason: P0Q1 records may be used for post-result P0-D diagnosis but cannot confirm a revision developed from them.

future_P0Q2_if_used.reason: A revised qualification rule requires a new untouched qualification family if prospective P0-Q survival is claimed.

future_EEG_atlas.reason: Data used to teach or tune Engine rules cannot be presented as independent Atlas validation on the same forcing pathway.
